item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Wildcard domain support in Azure Firewall network rules
item.description:
Azure Firewall network rules now support wildcard domains in FQDN-based rules and are generally available. Customers can use patterns such as *.contoso.com to simplify rule management.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: Announcing: New Windows App client-side endpoints for Azure Virtual Desktop
item.description:
Windows App will start using three new wildcard FQDNs for client-side service traffic to Azure Virtual Desktop beginning in early October 2026. The domains are already part of the cloud-side connectivity requirements.

  • Source: Azure Updates
